newsitem.title: SPAIN: Greece issues 25 bln pta 7-yr matador. [CORRECTED 14:25 GMT, 10/7/97]
newsitem.headline: Greece issues 25 bln pta 7-yr matador. [CORRECTED 14:25 GMT, 10/7/97]

text.p: In MADRID story on July 9 datelined "Greece issues 7-year 25.0 billion peseta matador" the report should have said that the placement is private, Caja de Madrid said on Thursday. A corrected story follows.
Caja de Madrid has executed a 25 billion peseta seven-year FRN private placement issue for the Hellenic Republic of Greece, Caja de Madrid said on Thursday.
Due August 11, 2004, the deal pays a coupon of 6-month Libor plus 40 basis points and is capped at 7.95 percent. Pay date is August 11, and listing AIAF.
